newsitem.title: USA: Rock-Tenn to acquire Rite Paper Products.
newsitem.headline: Rock-Tenn to acquire Rite Paper Products.

text.p: Rock-Tenn Co said Friday that it has signed a definitive agreement to purchase privately held Rite Paper Products Inc for an undisclosed sum, consisting of cash and class A common stock.

Rite Paper is a manufacturer of laminated recycled paperboard products utilized primarily by the furniture industry, and had sales of about $20 million in 1996. Rock-Tenn makes recycled paperboard and laminated paperboard products.

Rock-Tenn said the addition of Rite Paper Products to Rock-Tenn's laminated recycled paperboard operations in Lynchburg, Virginia, Columbus, Indiana, Vineland, New Jersey and Otsego, Michigan will allow it to expand in the fast growing ready-to-assemble furniture market.
Consummation of the acquisition, said the company, is subject to customary conditions and regulatory approvals.
